description: A gathering place for Leichty family history, photographs, stories, and reunions.

reunion.label: 2027 Leichty Family Reunion
reunion.registration: Formal invitation and RSVP details will follow

schedule.detail: Check in at the welcome table, grab your nametag, and start catching up with cousins and kin.
Please be in the main pavilion hall promptly so we can capture our all-family picture with every branch and generation together.
Sit down and enjoy a catered lunch together — no need to worry about bringing main dishes or heating food!
A special hour to share favorite family stories, honor our elders, and revisit classic memories.
An open afternoon featuring yard games including cornhole and giant Jenga, board games, trivia, and time to visit our family memory tables and photo albums.
Celebrating our game champions, special recognitions, and closing announcements.
Hugs, goodbyes, and safe travels. Our designated cleanup crew will handle pack-down afterward, so everyone can relax and visit right up until departure.

whatToBring.title: Family Memorabilia
whatToBring.detail: Old photos, albums, scrapbooks, or heirlooms to display on the shared Memory Table.

whatToBring.title: Comfortable Attire
whatToBring.detail: We will have both indoor pavilion seating and lawn space for games outside.

whatToBring.title: Your Favorite Memories
whatToBring.detail: Think of a story or favorite memory of Grandpa John, Grandma Salome, or growing up in the family to share during our storytelling hour.
